tools.name: answer_faq
tools.description: Look up the site's own answer to a question about image-color-changer.com — pricing, privacy, supported formats, accounts, what happens to uploaded images. Returns the closest published answers rather than one guess, so pick the one that fits.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What image-color-changer.com costs: the free allowance, one-time credit packs, and the subscription tiers, plus what a credit is spent on. Prices are in EUR.

tools.name: list_image_tools
tools.description: List every single-purpose image tool on the site — resize, recolour, make transparent, crop, convert format, extract a palette, and so on. Each entry names the page slug to pass to open_tool. Pass a category to get the full description and parameters for a smaller set.

category.description: Restrict to one category and include full detail for each tool.

tools.name: open_tool
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to a page on this site by slug — anything search_site or list_image_tools returned. Once a tool page is open it registers its own tools for setting options and downloading the result.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search image-color-changer.com for the page that does a given job. Accepts plain English ("make my logo white", "cut out the background", "instagram banner"). Returns ranked pages with their URLs.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in plain English.
